'''Gold Squad''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military unit deployed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]]. A [[Scout/Legends|scout unit]], Gold Squad was part of [[Second Platoon]], and its members were armed with [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].
